name: Calderax Linnorm - Adult
description: Adult Calderax is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with black basalt plates and sulphurous vents. It seeks to reopen volcanic vents and destroy engines that steal geothermal heat. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Basalt Jaws
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Basalt Plates
abilities.description: Reduce each instance of physical damage dealt to the linnorm by 3.

abilities.name: Sulphur Eruption
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 physical damage and the target must mark 1 Stress from gas and hot fragments. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Trampling Charge
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Move up to Close range in a straight line and make an attack against each enemy crossed. Each success deals 3d8+6 physical damage and knocks the target back to Close range.

abilities.name: Pressure Release
abilities.description: When the linnorm marks Severe damage, mark a Stress to force every enemy within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or mark 1 Stress and be knocked back to Close range.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
